source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To display memory configuration (initialized by ABL) status
Check memory information (Socket/Frequency/Vendor name/Type/Size) based on the installed memory

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Memory information should be shown correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Memory Configuration: display the memory configuration and verify it shows correctly. This is done in the BIOS setup menu memory page, which the agent cannot enter.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator opens the BIOS memory-configuration page and confirms the memory info displays correctly; agent cannot enter BIOS setup.

original_test_intent: Visually verify that the ABL-initialized BIOS memory-status page correctly represents installed memory Socket, Frequency, Vendor name, Type and Size.
original_method: Establish the approved DIMM recipe and BIOS/ABL build, collect read-only SMBIOS/BMC inventory, have an operator capture every BIOS memory-page field, perform a field-level normalized comparison, and exit without changing settings.
manual_activity: A human must navigate to and visually verify the ABL/BIOS page and its five displayed fields. Automated inventory comparison assists evidence but does not perform that acceptance observation.
safety_requirements: Use the BIOS page read-only and do not save memory-setting changes.
Stop on topology mismatch, accidental write or boot issue.
agent_execution_scope: Collect/parse read-only SMBIOS/BMC memory evidence after approval.
Compare supplied BIOS captures field by field against the recipe.
Inspect the existing project script when supplied and report discrepancies without claiming UI observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Capture every required BIOS/ABL field without changes.
Resolve representation differences and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly retains operator UI observation but provides no automated command.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Prefer the preserved project script after version/content review for comparison support; retain the BIOS page as primary evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Socket, Frequency, Vendor name, Type, Size, script URL and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-socket table joining the photographed BIOS fields, physical BOM and full SMBIOS/BMC records, with explicit speed/unit/vendor normalization.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact AMD board, ABL/BIOS and installed DIMM topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/ABL/BMC, dmidecode and project-script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner DIMM recipe and platform memory-status specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds structured cross-source reconciliation while preserving visual UI acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Configured, rated and trained frequency may differ and need an approved interpretation.

project_override_considerations: The project supplies installed topology and accepted naming/unit rules. Different approved DIMM populations are separate plan executions and do not rewrite the master five-field requirement.
expected_evidence: Timestamped BIOS page showing all five fields per socket/device
Unchanged configuration/normal boot and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require installed-memory information. Project-specific values and representation mappings are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear and manually observable; missing recipe, console, inventory or script is readiness, not permanent blockage.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its manual boundary and adds precise five-field evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its useful automated comparison but reclassifies to MANUAL ONLY because UI observation is the core acceptance, not merely environment setup.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent assistance and engineer verdict under the locked manual-activity rule.

review_improvement: Prevents automated SMBIOS agreement from being claimed as proof of what the ABL-initialized BIOS page displays, while making the manual result objectively comparable.
independent_technical_reasoning: All five decisive values must be shown on a named BIOS page. Machine-readable inventory is valuable corroboration, but because human UI observation remains core, V3.1 requires MANUAL ONLY rather than PARTIAL.
no_automatic_retry: Do not re-enter BIOS or rerun inventory automatically after a mismatch; preserve raw/UI evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
